description: This file defines the MediaCodecWrapper class that simplifies interactions with Android's MediaCodec API, providing buffer management, callback interfaces, and factory methods for creating codec instances for video decoding.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class around Android's MediaCodec to manage buffer processing, callback handling, and decoding operations for media streams.

methods.name: fromVideoFormat
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaCodecWrapper instance for decoding video based on provided MediaFormat and Surface.

methods.name: stopAndRelease
methods.description: Stops the codec and releases resources.

methods.name: setOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for output format change events, with an optional handler.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Queues a media sample ByteBuffer into the decoder for processing.

methods.name: peekSample
methods.description: Peeks at the current output buffer info without releasing it.

methods.name: popSample
methods.description: Releases and optionally renders the current output buffer, notifying listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes internal buffer queues with the internal state of the MediaCodec.
